a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first means we both very likely die after round 1. The reserve only holds 4, so only one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so you may prefer to operate or wait. If the storms hold off, I'll keep operating with you afterward to help you reach 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
